design:
Verified CLI facts (claude 2.1.316 installed): `claude plugin list --json [--available]` returns [{id:'name@marketplace',version,scope,enabled,installPath,installedAt,lastUpdated,projectEnabled}]; `plugin install|enable|disable|uninstall|update <id> [-s user|project|local] [--json]`; `plugin marketplace add <src> [--scope] [--json]|list --json|remove|update`; `claude mcp login <name> [--no-browser]` and `claude mcp logout <name>` EXIST, so OAuth for needs-auth servers is just spawning `claude mcp login`. No need for terminal fallback (keep spawn-in-window fallback only if login exits non-zero). `claude mcp add` exists and is already wrapped.

Main process (new file src/extensoes.js is optional; KISS: put in main.js next to mcp handlers, ~line 1080, or extract to src/extensoes.js exporting pure helpers: lerSkills, criarSkill, modeloSkill, catalogo):
1. MCP logs: `const logsMcp = new Map()` name -> string[] ring (cap 200 lines/server) plus key '*' general. `registraLogMcp(chunk)`: split lines, strip ANSI, attribute to a server when the line contains a known server name (`/\[?MCP[^\]]*\]?.*?"?([\w.-]+)"?/i` or match against names from last mcpServerStatus kept in `nomesMcp` Set updated in the painel handler line 1098), else store under '*'. Wire in query() line 72: `extra.stderr = registraLogMcp`. Also push `erro` from mcpServerStatus into the ring when status==='failed' (painel handler). IPC `mcp_logs` (nome) -> {linhas}; `mcp_logs_limpar`. Optional 'Abrir pasta de logs' = shell.openPath(path.join(os.homedir(),'.claude')) is not required.
2. MCP OAuth: extend mcp_acao with acao 'entrar': spawn comandoClaude(exe,['mcp','login',nome]) (copy pattern of claude_entrar 1654, 3 min timeout, stream output via enviarEvento tipo 'mcp_login' {nome, texto, fim, codigo}), on code 0 call esquecePainel() and comConsulta(j,q=>q.reconnectMcpServer(nome)) / reabreConversas(); acao 'sair' runs `claudeCli(['mcp','logout',nome])`. Renderer shows 'Entrar' for estado 'needs-auth' (painel.js mcpLinha) and 'Sair' for http/sse connected.
3. Connector catalog: static JSON src/catalogo-conectores.json [{id,nome,descricao,url,transporte:'http',categoria,auth:'oauth'|'chave'}] (Notion https://mcp.notion.com/mcp, Linear https://mcp.linear.app/mcp, Sentry https://mcp.sentry.dev/mcp, GitHub, Atlassian, Asana, Stripe, PayPal, Figma, Cloudflare, Context7, etc.; verify URLs at implementation). IPC `conectores_catalogo` returns it flagged 'jaAdicionado' from painel status names; one-click 'Adicionar' calls the existing mcp_adicionar logic with {nome:id,transporte:'http',url,escopo:'user'}, then if auth==='oauth' offers 'Entrar' (step 2).
4. Plugins: helper `claudeJson(args,cwd)` = claudeCli with max 4MB and JSON.parse of stdout (last line for --json action results). IPC `plugins_lista` -> {instalados: plugin list --json, disponiveis: plugin list --json --available, mercados: plugin marketplace list --json} (comCache 20s; invalidate with esquecePainel-like `respostas.delete('plugins|*')` after any action). IPC `plugin_acao` {acao: instalar|ativar|desativar|desinstalar|atualizar, id, escopo} validated: id /^[\w.@-]{1,120}$/, escopo in ESCOPOS_MCP, maps to ['plugin', verb, id, '-s', escopo, '--json']; on success reabreConversas() (SDK restart picks it up; update says restart required). IPC `mercado_acao` {acao: add|remove|update, fonte, escopo} -> `plugin marketplace add <src> --scope` etc., fonte validated non-empty, no leading '-'. Skip --accept-command prompts: if result mentions shownCommand, surface message telling the person to run in terminal. Renderer tab 'Plugins': marketplace list + add field, installed list with switch (chave) / Atualizar / Remover (two-step confirm like mcpConfirma painel.js:75), available list with search and Instalar.
5. Skills manager: `lerSkills(cwd)` scans ~/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md and <cwd>/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md (fs.readdirSync withFileTypes), parses frontmatter with a tiny regex (^---\n([\s\S]*?)\n---) key: value lines -> {nome, descricao, origem:'user'|'projeto', pasta, desligada}. IPC `skills_lista`. `skill_criar` {nome (/^[a-z0-9-]{1,64}$/), descricao, escopo:'user'|'projeto'}: refuse if folder exists, mkdir + write template SKILL.md (frontmatter name/description + body). `skills_pasta` {origem}: shell.openPath of the computed dir (mkdir first) - path never from renderer; also `skill_abrir` to showItemInFolder the SKILL.md. Enable/disable: store in config.skillsDesligadas[chaveMcp(cwd)|'user'] pattern (guardaDesligado clone) and apply by passing it to query options; BUT SDK option for skill filtering must be confirmed in docs (Options.skills / settings.skillOverrides); if absent, implement disable by renaming SKILL.md to SKILL.md.desligada (reversible, simple, works for both CLI and SDK). Recommend the rename approach. After change: esquece cache of 'comandos' (main.js:320, 10 min cache) and reabreConversas().
6. Renderer: new src/renderer/extensoes.js with `desenhaPlugins(corpoP)`, `desenhaSkills(corpoP)`, `desenhaConectores(corpoP)` called from desenhaAba branches in personalizar.js; each renders HTML strings and binds via data-acao handlers; busy/msg state vars like mcpOcupado/mcpMsg in painel.js. Logs: <details class="pz-lista"><pre class="ext-log"> fetched via vivo.mcpLogs(nome), refresh button.
7. Preload: add ipcRenderer.invoke one-liners. i18n: add parts/extensoes.json (en + vi) for all new pt strings. README/docs: add a short Customize section and note CLI >= 2.1.x requirement for `claude mcp login` and `plugin` commands.

risks: SDK `stderr` callback receives raw Claude Code process stderr, not structured per-server logs; attribution by server-name substring is heuristic, so unattributed lines go to a general bucket. Claude Code may only emit MCP debug output with --debug/DEBUG; may need extraArgs {debug:null} or `debug-to-stderr` (confirm in SDK docs, can't read node_modules).

Plugin install may require interactive confirmation (marketplace-declared commands, userConfig prompts via --config) and may exit non-zero without a TTY; surface message and tell the person to finish in a terminal.
claudeCli truncates to 1500 chars and times out at 45s: plugin list --available and git-backed marketplace add/install can exceed; must raise limits.
Plugins and skills load at Claude Code start: need reabreConversas() and cache invalidation of 'comandos' (main.js:320) and painel cache, else UI shows stale state.
Skill enable/disable has no verified official SDK setting; rename approach touches user files in ~/.claude/skills, and plugin-provided skills are not scanned (only user/project dirs).
Path safety: skill names and plugin ids/sources come from the renderer; validate with strict regexes, compute folders in main only, never pass leading '-' values to the CLI (use '--' or validate).
Catalog URLs for remote MCP servers can change; keep list small and verify each at implementation; `claude mcp login` needs CLI version that has it (2.1.316 does).
Scope creep in personalizar.js (436 lines): keep new tabs in extensoes.js. Personalizar is the closest existing 'Customize' surface; the Painel (details) stays for per-conversation status.
